content.text: -    MOA: inhibit 5HT-r — mesolimbic DA-D2 -> ↓+sx · mesocortical ↓5HT -> ↓-sx, help mood

-    SE: EPS/tardive dyskinesia -> anticholinergic · dystonia -> IM anticholinergic · parkinsonian -> PO anticholinergic · benztropine (Cogentin) IM 1-2 mg acute dystonia (PO 1-4 mg/day EPS) · trihexyphenidyl PO 5-15 mg/day (FYI)
-    Pt ed: screen EPS scales, PANSS
▪︎Clin Use: bipolar depression (MDE in bipolar I/II) — 1st-line FDA-approved monotx
-    SE: ↑sedation · mod anticholinergic · very ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden ♡ death · hyperprolactinemia
-    SE: ↑sedation · mod anticholinergic · ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden ♡ death · hyperprolactinemia
-    MOA: weak D2 (↓occupancy) + strong 5HT2A/D4/M1/H1 antagonist -> refractory efficacy + ⍉ EPS    -    met by CYP1A2 (smoke induces -> ↓levels)
-    Monitoring: ANC baseline ≥1500 (BEN ≥1000) · wkly x6M, q2wk M7-12, monthly after
-    Pt ed: levels ↓ by tobacco · ↑ by caffeine
-    BBW: severe neutropenia/agranulocytosis (ANC monitoring) · life-threatening · reserved for failed 2+ OR suicide risk · ↑Sz · orthostasis · fatal myocarditis/myopathy · ↑death (elderly, dementia)
-    Admin: PO · IM · SC — IM needs 3wk overlap of doses until therapeutic
-    SE: ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden ♡ death
-    Caution: ↑QTc — greatest of atypicals (⍉ w QT drugs/congenital long QT/recent MI/uncomp HF)
▪︎Clin Use: bipolar depression (MDE in bipolar I/II) — 1st-line FDA-approved monotx
-    SE: ↓sedation · ↓anticholinergic · mod EPS · ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden ♡ death · hyperprolactinemia
-    MOA: D2 partial agonist -> DA stabilizer (partial DA tone: ⍉ overstim mesolimbic, ⍉ full block -> ↓EPS/PRL)
-    Clin Use: psychotic dx · BD · adj MDD
-    SE: ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · very ↓EPS · very ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden ♡ death
-    Note: DA-D2 block in medulla CTZ -> antiemetic
-    MOA: D2 + 5HT2A antagonist — active metabolite of risperidone
-    Admin: PO · IM — 6 mg/day (3-12) · LAI: Sustenna/Trinza/Hafyera
-    Caution: PRL ↑ (like risperidone) · modest QTc · renal dosing
-    MOA: D2/D3 partial agonist -> DA stabilizer (D3-preferring)
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar mania + depression · MDD adj
-    Caution: long t½ — monitor response several wk after dose chg · EPS/akathisia dose-related
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar mania (mono + adj)
-    Admin: SL (Saphris) 5-10 mg BID — ⍉ swallow/chew · ⍉ eat/drink 10 min after · transdermal patch (Secuado) q24h
-    Caution: QT prolongation · orthostasis — 7-day titration required
-    MOA: D2 partial agonist + 5HT2A antagonist + glutamatergic
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar depression (mono/adj) · MDD adj
-    Admin: PO · 42 mg/day, ⍉titration · hepatic impair (Child-Pugh B/C) 21 mg qday · taper none specified
-    Caution: EPS/met ≈ placebo · somnolence 24% · CYP3A4 dose adj
•newest agents (aripiprazole, brexipiprazole, cariprazine) – partial agonists @ D2 & 5HT1A receptors
•Brexipiprazole has an additional mech as an antagonist @ 5HT2A receptors

•⍉effect on or minimally elevates PRL levels
•Met (wt gain, lipids, blood sugar) – highest risk COQ; clozapine, olanzapine, quetiapine
